Riley (People Ops): Quick notice 1026 attestation window opens Fri 09:00 PT. Two required actions per team by close: (1) everyone completes the 12-min privacy microtraining, (2) each team uploads one SOC2-relevant artifact OR files a ticket assigning an evidence owner.
Riley (People Ops): Portal + checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/attestations. Preferred upload path: /attestations/2026/<team>/. Deadline: 2026-07-10 17:00 PT.
Kara (Security): Auditors accept owner-assigned tickets as interim evidence. Sampled teams (~10%) will be asked for additional exports (IAM, KMS rotation, backups).
Dmitri (Infra): We have a maintenance window Fri night. Can infra request a short extension?
Riley (People Ops): Yes 16-72h scoped extension allowed for release conflicts. Create ticket `Compliance extension - <team> - <reason>` and cc @Kara. Training still due on time.
Samir (Product): For small product squads (<4), can PMs attest for contractors?
Riley (People Ops): Managers may attest for small squads but list individual names in the ticket. Contractors should either upload certs or be covered by a manager attestation note.
Training Bot: Assigned course "Privacy Refresher 2026" to all employees. Link: https://learning.redwood.ai/course/privacy-refresher-2026
Compliance Bot: Auto-reminders scheduled 72h/48h/24h before close. Teams missing items will receive DMs and an @here ping in #people-ops.
Kara (Security): Artifact examples: runbook/playbook (PDF/MD), IAM export (CSV), backup manifest, KMS rotation export, change-control ticket with approvals. If you need redaction help, tag Legal.
Dmitri (Infra): Uploaded our rotation export to /attestations/2026/infra and created ticket `infra - Attestation 2026 - owner: Dmitri`.
Riley (People Ops): Thanks all 1 If unsure what to upload, file a ticket `TEAM - Attestation 2026 - owner: <name>` with ETA and mark `evidence: pending` 1 auditors accept that as interim evidence. Office hours Mon 10:00 PT with Security. We'll post final 6h @here reminder.
